sentences.text: Finally a week's time is granted to remove Office objections, failing which petition will be dismissed for default.

In the meanwhile, the learned HCGP is directed to verify the status of the case in Cr.No.8/2022 of Mangaluru Women Police Station."
Even today, the learned counsel for petitioner has not complied with the office objections.
Therefore, the petition is dismissed for its non-prosecution.
